import { cartItems } from '../data/products'; function Cart() { const subtotal = cartItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0); const shipping = 0; const total = subtotal + shipping; return (

YOUR CART

{cartItems.length} items ready to checkout.

{cartItems.map((item) => (

{item.name}

Size {item.size} · {item.tag}

${item.price}

))}

Order Summary

Subtotal ${subtotal}
Shipping {shipping === 0 ? 'Free' : `$${shipping}`}
Total ${total}

Free express shipping for VELOCE Elite members.

); } export default Cart;
